name: 项目成本汇总查询
description: 按项目汇总报销成本并计算偏差率
statement: SELECT p.project_no, p.project_name, p.total_budget, SUM(e.total_amount) AS expense_total, SUM(e.total_amount) - p.total_budget AS variance, ROUND((SUM(e.total_amount) - p.total_budget) * 100.0 / p.total_budget, 2) AS variance_rate FROM 项目主表 p LEFT JOIN 报销主表 e ON p.project_no = e.project_no GROUP BY p.project_no
sql: SELECT p.project_no, p.project_name, p.total_budget, SUM(e.total_amount) AS expense_total, SUM(e.total_amount) - p.total_budget AS variance, ROUND((SUM(e.total_amount) - p.total_budget) * 100.0 / p.total_budget, 2) AS variance_rate FROM 项目主表 p LEFT JOIN 报销主表 e ON p.project_no = e.project_no GROUP BY p.project_no
